subject: Post-call: FinPort infra constraints and deployment options (SSO / KMS / Logs)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@finport.com>; Marcus Li <marcus.li@finport.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: FinPort infra constraints and deployment options (SSO / KMS / Logs)

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation and I appreciate the clear constraints you shared. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Recap (what we captured)
- Primary security needs: company-wide SSO via Okta (OIDC + SCIM), enforced MFA, SAML optional for some teams.
- Key management: customer-managed keys required; HSM/KMS integration (AWS KMS or Thales HSM via KMIP) for encryption-at-rest of model artifacts and us-to-customer key wrapping.
- Logging & retention: audit logs must be retained 7 years in immutable storage for compliance; access-controlled export to your logging endpoint (S3/CloudWatch/ELK).
- Data residency: production inference in us-east-1 only.
- Throughput: steady-state ~150 rps embedding/text gen, short bursts to 1k rps during batch runs.

Initial deployment recommendation (based on constraints)
- Hosted API: quickest for POC but does NOT meet customer-managed KMS/HSM or 7-year immutable log retention requirements.
- Dedicated capacity: likely fit if we can enable customer-managed KMS and extend log export/retention policy to meet your compliance needs. Dedicated gives predictable throughput and isolated GPU pools.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): the safe choice if your procurement/legal teams require full control over keys, network egress, and air-gap policies. Longer lead time and procurement complexity.

Ask / Next steps
1) Attached an initial RFI answers doc (FinPort_RFI_answers_v0.pdf) — please review and flag any clarifications.
2) Could you confirm the IdP metadata (Okta tenant URL + SCIM admin email) so Dev and Neha can validate SSO flow?
3) Procurement: Marcus, what timelines are you targeting for the compliance review and decision (weeks)?
4) We'll put together a short Mutual Action Plan and a Dedicated architecture sketch — sharing by EOD.

Attachments: FinPort_RFI_answers_v0.pdf (PDF, 98KB), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the next technical sync after we have the IdP/KMS info.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@finport.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@finport.com>, FinPort Procurement <it-procurement@finport.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinPort infra constraints and deployment options (SSO / KMS / Logs)

Jordan — thanks for the thorough recap. Quick clarifications inline: 

- Okta: we will provide metadata. SCIM provisioning will be used for automated user sync, SCIM admin is scim-admin@finport.com.
- KMS/HSM: procurement prefers AWS KMS with an option for HSM-backed CMKs (via CloudHSM) — we cannot accept vendor-managed keys.
- Logs: 7-year retention is non-negotiable; logs must be write-once (WORM) to an S3 bucket with object lock. We can give a dedicated account/bucket for Redwood exports.
- Data residency: confirmed: us-east-1.

Timeline: procurement/compliance review target is 6–8 weeks; security team needs a short design review next week if possible.

Please include the Dedicated architecture diagram and any notes about how Redwood will configure KMS wrapping and log exports.

Appreciate the speed — happy to get the MSP/solutions team involved.

Best,
Alice Roberts
Senior IT Ops / Security Liaison
FinPort
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: FinPort infra constraints and deployment options (SSO / KMS / Logs)

Jordan — quick internal note based on Alice's replies.

Summary of technical gaps to validate before recommending Dedicated vs Private:
- KMS integration: we need to confirm that FinPort will allow an external CMK in their account (we can support AWS KMS CMKs in customer account) OR we need to run in Private with CloudHSM.
- HSM requirement: if they insist on on-prem HSM + no external key material, Private is the default.
- S3 WORM: we can implement object-locked S3 export into their account; need an S3 ARN and IAM role to assume.
- Network isolation: Dedicated supports VPC peering + transit gateway; for stricter egress controls they should consider Private.

Action items: 
- Jordan: ask for Okta metadata and the S3 bucket ARN + encryption policy.
- Neha: prepare a one-page security summary describing KMS options, HSM requirements, and log export flow for the FinPort security team.
- I'll draft a Dedicated architecture sketch (attached) showing how CMK in customer account is used to wrap model artifacts and how logs are exported.

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-arch.png (PNG, 220KB)

Thanks — Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@finport.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@finport.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps & items we need from FinPort

Alice / Marcus — thanks for the confirmations. To keep the security/design review productive, can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday: 
1) Okta metadata file (XML) + SCIM admin email (you already provided scim-admin@finport.com).
2) S3 bucket ARN for write-once logs and a cross-account IAM role name to assume for log export.
3) Confirmation whether AWS KMS CMKs in FinPort account will be used, or if CloudHSM-only is required.

I've opened a short HubSpot MLP and shared a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that maps milestones to owners/timelines. For procurement convenience, I can also post a sanitized Dedicated pricing brief if that helps compare cost/lead time vs Private.

DocuSign: I'll send a non-binding MOU after we align on the architecture so your procurement team can see estimated T&Cs. Link will follow once you confirm the S3/KMS answers.

Proposed date for security design review: Tue Apr 20, 2026 10:00 AM ET — Dev and Neha will join to walk the architecture. Please let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Roberts <alice.roberts@finport.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@finport.com>, FinPort Procurement <it-procurement@finport.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & items we need from FinPort

Jordan — sounds good. We will: 
- Upload Okta metadata and the S3 ARN to the shared secure folder by Monday EOD.
- Procurement target remains ~6 weeks; security review confirmed for Tue Apr 20 10am ET.
- For now, we will plan to use AWS KMS CMKs in our account; CloudHSM-only is not required but we reserve the right to escalate if compliance flags arise.

Please go ahead and share the Dedicated pricing brief and MOU when ready. Marcus will coordinate with procurement on the MOU review.

Alice
Senior IT Ops / Security Liaison | FinPort
